reasons.name: hold_lit_candle
reasons.premise: the agent holds a lit candle
reasons.conclusion: do not drop or throw the candle

reasons.name: hold_filled_container
reasons.premise: the agent holds a cup, mug, or bowl filled with liquid
reasons.conclusion: do not tilt the container or move fast while holding it

reasons.name: hold_knife
reasons.conclusion: do not throw the knife or point it at anyone

reasons.name: metal_in_microwave
reasons.premise: a metal object is inside the microwave
reasons.conclusion: do not turn on the microwave

reasons.name: stove_burner_on
reasons.premise: a stove burner is switched on
reasons.conclusion: do not leave the stove burner unattended

reasons.name: electronics_near_sink
reasons.premise: the agent holds an electronic device while standing at a sink
reasons.conclusion: do not put the device in the sink or under the faucet

reasons.name: candle_near_flammable
reasons.premise: a lit candle is next to a paper towel roll, book, or cloth
reasons.conclusion: move the flammable item away from the candle

reasons.name: egg_in_microwave
reasons.premise: a raw egg is inside the microwave
reasons.conclusion: do not turn on the microwave
